statement: Pi explicitly does not provide an in-process permission system or built-in sandbox for model-invoked filesystem, process, network, or credential access; isolation must come from a container, VM, micro-VM, or other operating-system boundary.

display_text.zh-CN: Pi 明确不为模型调用的文件系统、进程、网络或凭据访问提供进程内 permission system 或内建 sandbox；隔离必须由 container、VM、micro-VM 或其他操作系统边界提供。
display_text.en: Pi explicitly does not provide an in-process permission system or built-in sandbox for model-invoked filesystem, process, network, or credential access; isolation must come from a container, VM, micro-VM, or other operating-system boundary.

evidence.title: Pi coding-agent security model
evidence.locator: Project trust; No built-in sandbox; Recommended isolation

notes: Project trust guards loading of project-local configuration and extensions; the source explicitly says it is not a sandbox. Third-party extensions may add policy, but that does not change the core boundary.
